prompt: What does this print when day is 2?
explanation: In the classic switch form a case is an entry point, not a box. Execution starts at case 2 and keeps going into every case below it until it meets a break or the end, so all three lines print. Adding break to each case - or using the arrow form, which does not fall through - fixes it.
hints: A case label says where to start, not where to stop.
What ends a case other than reaching the closing brace?
